# Amazon Is Said to Pay $7.5 Billion for AI Startup Decart’s Tech

By Matt Day

November 23, 2026 at 8:48 AM EST

## Takeaways by Bloomberg AI

Amazon.com Inc. has agreed to acquire much of startup Decart AI, buying tools to bolster the cloud-computing company’s artificial intelligence infrastructure.

Amazon will get the technology behind the Decart Optimization Stack, software designed to make AI models run smoothly across a range of hardware, as well as Decart’s founding team and their AI researchers and engineers, the company said in a blog post on Monday.
